source.snippet: I run a small business and am looking for a reliable way to track my team's working hours across different projects. I want to manage timesheets, monitor project progress, and understand how employees spend their time without creating additional administrative work.

problem_statement: Small business owners need lightweight multi-project time tracking that integrates timesheets with project progress visibility, but existing tools either create too much admin overhead or bundle too many unused features.
target_segment: Small business owners and team leads managing 2–20 person teams across multiple simultaneous client projects.
notes: Business owner explicitly seeking a paid tool solution. Market is crowded (Toggl, Harvest, Clockify) but pain around 'additional administrative work' suggests a gap in low-friction UX. Moderate buyer intent.
